evidence.message: The compact rule does not recover the original x19 identity

limitations: Only the documented, bounded integer instruction subset is interpreted.
Checks describe selected modeled states; they do not establish whole-function or asynchronous unwind correctness.
SIMD, pointer authentication, DWARF FDE evaluation, personality and LSDA semantics are outside this model.
Direct callees are summarized as ABI-conforming returns preserving SP, x19–x29 and unescaped allocated stack storage; callees are not analyzed.

requirements: Verify architecture and selected-slice SHA-256 before applying an address to an open image.
Use UUID as additional image identity when present; a matching filename is insufficient.
Addresses are preferred unslid VM addresses; apply a verified runtime slide only in a runtime-aware adapter.
This export defines a proposed adapter contract. It does not assume an existing MacScope GUI deep link or import command.
